note: Track R and Track C are reported separately and are never pooled. They measure different things: natural-domain behaviour, and routing under known conditions.

ACTION_SELECTION_ACCURACY.definition: scenarios whose first selected action equalled the action preregistered for that variant

ACTION_SELECTION_ACCURACY_secondary.definition: same, restricted to bases whose REFERENCE produced a valid foreground; separates wrong routing from perception never reaching the routing question

BOUNDED_EXECUTION_RATE.definition: scenarios finishing inside the declared 24-step budget

DECISION_ATTRIBUTION_RATE.definition: recorded decisions carrying an action, a reason code and either the evidence ids it rests on or an explanation naming them

FAIL_SAFE_RATE.definition: scenarios whose condition is unrecoverable by construction that refused rather than produced a result; denominator is SEVERE_BLUR

REMEDIATION_HARM_RATE.definition: corrections applied and then rejected at re-measurement

REMEDIATION_SUCCESS_RATE.definition: applied corrections that survived re-measurement; denominator is corrections attempted on recoverable variants

TASK_SUCCESS_RATE.definition: scenarios matching the preregistered action AND model invocation AND terminal state

TRACE_COMPLETENESS_RATE.definition: traces retrievable by run id where every step carries its step id and both states

UNNECESSARY_TOOL_CALL_RATE.definition: scenarios that preregistered the model must not run, where it ran anyway; denominator is those scenarios only

UNSAFE_INFERENCE_RATE.definition: scenarios where the model ran despite a blocking terminal state

COMPLETE_INSPECTION_RATE.definition: images that reached a condition result. NOT accuracy.

ELIGIBLE_FOR_INFERENCE_RATE.definition: images that reached the state permitting the condition model to run

FOREGROUND_VALID_RATE.definition: images where the primary segmenter produced a mask that passed the geometric guards

HUMAN_ACTION_RATE.definition: images ending in a request directed at a person

INSUFFICIENT_VISUAL_EVIDENCE_RATE.definition: images where no usable subject region could be isolated, so no ROI-dependent measurement was attempted

RECAPTURE_RATE.definition: images the agent asked to be recaptured

REMEDIATION_ACCEPTANCE_RATE.definition: corrections whose re-measurement was good enough to keep; denominator is attempts, not images

REMEDIATION_ATTEMPT_RATE.definition: images where an automated correction was applied

TRACE_COMPLETENESS_RATE.definition: traces retrievable by run id where every step carries its step id and both states

UNSAFE_INFERENCE_RATE.definition: runs where the condition model ran despite a blocking terminal state. This is the metric that must be zero.

trace_retrievable.definition: traces fetched back out of the service by run id
